Version 1.0.6 makes the default workspace roomier and progress reporting more truthful.

- The default window is now 1400x900, giving the Audio Sync track table and Summary enough room together.
- Audio Sync advances the progress bar for completed checkpoints instead of pulsing during each checkpoint.
- Organizer analysis milestones now appear as determinate progress before mkvmerge reports its own remux percentage.
- Truly unmeasurable preparation work can still use the indeterminate state.
